verdict.rationale: A public CoreWeave pricing page exists, but the cited text is only marketing copy about On-Demand and Spot capacity and "great pricing." Nothing in the evidence shows actual per-GPU-hour prices for any GPU type, let alone every type. The billing docs cover usage insights and cost export for existing customers, not published list prices.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see the published per-GPU-hour price for every GPU type on a public pricing page without talking to sales
